svg.title: Wind turbine technician — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as wind turbine technician, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: Three long separated wind-turbine blades surround a small hub above a mast with one access rung. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
